# 05 · Sensors for UAVs

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

What each sensor buys you, how gyros, accelerometers, magnetometers, barometers, GNSS receivers, optical flow and rangefinders actually work, and the noise, bias, drift, mounting and calibration that decide whether the flight controller can trust them.
